climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A California mountain AVA on the Monterey and San Benito County line that includes Chalone and Mt. Harlan. At an average 2,370 feet it sits above the fog, so the air is cool without the humidity, and it has 4 wineries and 6 vineyards.
